parsed.note_claim: The videos and incident depicted are from the runway collision at Tokyo Haneda Airport (the note says January 2, 2027, though the cited page dates it to 2024).
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: On 2 January 2024, a runway collision occurred at Haneda Airport in Tokyo, Japan, involving an Airbus A350, operating as Japan Airlines Flight 516, and a De Havilland Canada Dash 8 operated by the Japan Coast Guard (JA722A).
parsed.reason: The page substantiates the core claim that a runway collision with a fire occurred at Tokyo Haneda Airport on January 2, which is the incident the note identifies; the note's year (2027) conflicts with the page's 2024, but it appears to be a typo, since the note's own URLs say 2024.
